messages:
anika-partnerships: APAC SI wants a marketplace private-offer that looks like one SKU: 12mo software commit + 3% hardware rebate, plus auto-renew protection and a conversion credit if they overshoot. can we scope?

mike-sales: need: single bundle UI, 30d renew protect, conversion credit up to 20% of Q1 overage as future credit. also cap hw rebate.

sarah-ops: FYI marketplace backend usually needs separate SKUs; negative one-time line items often blocked in sandbox. we should validate voucher flow.

anika-partnerships: proposal: bundle UI maps to commit SKU + issue voucher for hw rebate after install verification; conversion credit = voucher too.

josh-product: agree. define mapping and guardrails: bundle_sku -> REDW-COMMIT-12 + REDW-HW-VOUCHER; renew lock 30d, downward price change cap 5%; voucher expiry 90d.

mike-sales: commercial: cap hw rebate $200k/account; require serials + install proof for redemption. i'll draft T&Cs.

sarah-ops: ops plan: test voucher issuance in staging, webhook to mint conversion-credit voucher. timeline ~2 sprints for voucher path; negative-line item path needs marketplace approvals.

marketplace-bot: private-offer-validator: sandbox detected : negative-priced line items rejected. recommend voucher post-provision flow.

anika-partnerships: actions: @mike-sales draft terms EOD Wed, @sarah-ops start staging tests, @josh-product mock bundle UI. i'll confirm SI install checklist next Tue. :thumbsup:
